items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This the regular mouthpiece you blow with it, Milly? ... Sometime Milly I'm going to take that and work on it.

ctx.x: That's the funny thing, huh? Mm-hmm. Yeah. Yeah.
This the regular mouthpiece you blow with it, Milly? Yeah.
I had a bunch of reasons. I don't know what to come out of this, you know. I always care of that too, now. I haven't cared for that.
